title: steps/agentTrigger payload
description: Payload for the agentTrigger hook. Fires when an agent is activated.

trigger_source.description: Source descriptor; shape depends on trigger_type

intent.description: Optional Intent for the session (IBAC adopters populate). If sessionStart already established a canonical session Intent, this field MUST match it (or be omitted); if sessionStart omitted Intent (for example on an unattended scheduled, external_event, a2a_inbound, or system activation), the first agentTrigger carrying Intent establishes the canonical session Intent, and any subsequent agentTrigger proposing a different Intent MUST be rejected (Specification §8.4).
